ex: 我爷爷很喜欢听京剧。
My grandpa loves listening to Beijing opera.
今晚我们去看一场京剧吧。
Let's go and see a Beijing opera tonight.
use: Measure word 场 or 出; 唱京剧 = sing Beijing opera.

m: **Borrow** a **bronze mirror** to look at how others did it: to **learn from**.
ex: 我们可以借鉴别人的经验。
We can learn from other people's experience.
这个设计借鉴了中国传统建筑。
This design draws on traditional Chinese architecture.
use: Formal; often 借鉴经验, 借鉴……的做法.

m: The **name** is **secondary** to **his** **real** self, and both match: **true to its name**.
ex: 他是一位名副其实的好老师。
He is a good teacher in every sense of the word.
这里真是名副其实的花城。
This really is a city of flowers, true to its name.
use: Often 名副其实的 + noun; opposite 名不副实.

m: The **wind** of **custom** blowing through a place: **social customs**.
ex: 每个地方都有自己的风俗。
Every place has its own customs.
过年吃饺子是北方的风俗。
Eating dumplings at New Year is a northern custom.
use: Often 风俗习惯 (customs and habits).

ex: 她每天照很多次镜子。
She looks in the mirror many times a day.
墙上挂着一面镜子。
A mirror hangs on the wall.
use: Measure word 面; 照镜子 = look in the mirror.

m: Someone who **grew** up on a far **raised path**: **unfamiliar**, a stranger.
ex: 不要跟陌生人走。
Don't go off with strangers.
这个城市对我来说很陌生。
This city is unfamiliar to me.
use: 陌生人 = stranger; opposite 熟悉.

ex: 这个地区经常发生自然灾害。
Natural disasters often happen in this region.
洪水给农民带来了很大灾害。
The floods brought great harm to the farmers.
use: Often 自然灾害 (natural disaster).

ex: 这口钟是用铜铸造的。
This bell was cast in bronze.
工厂里正在铸造零件。
The factory is casting parts.
use: Technical; also figurative (铸造辉煌, forge glory).

ex: 我们在客厅看电视。
We watch TV in the living room.
他家的客厅很大。
His living room is very big.
use: Measure word 间 or 个.

ex: 这里的土地很肥沃。
The land here is very fertile.
河边有一片肥沃的田地。
There are fertile fields by the river.
use: Only for soil and land.

m: What you **report** back to someone who **entertained** you: a **reward**, pay.
ex: 这份工作的报酬不错。
This job pays well.
他帮忙从来不要报酬。
He never asks for payment when he helps.
use: Payment for work; 工资 is a regular salary.

ex: 他顽强地活了下来。
He tenaciously survived.
这是一支很顽强的队伍。
This is a very tough team.
use: Praise for fighting spirit; with 地 before verbs.

ex: 毕业典礼在礼堂举行。
The graduation ceremony is held in the auditorium.
我参加了他们的结婚典礼。
I attended their wedding ceremony.
use: Formal; 举行典礼 = hold a ceremony.

ex: 你会用筷子吗？
Can you use chopsticks?
请给我一双筷子。
Please give me a pair of chopsticks.
use: Measure word 双 (pair), 根 (one stick).

m: The **mountain pass** by the **ocean** where goods are checked: **customs**.
ex: 过海关的时候要检查行李。
Your luggage is checked when you go through customs.
这些东西被海关扣留了。
These items were held by customs.
use: 过海关 = go through customs.

ex: 妈妈给我使了个眼色。
Mum gave me a meaningful look.
他很会看别人的眼色。
He is good at reading people's expressions.
use: 使眼色 = wink, signal; 看眼色 = read the room.

m: **Satire** with a **thorn** in it: to **satirize**, to **mock**.
ex: 这部电影讽刺了社会上的一些现象。
This film satirizes certain social phenomena.
他的话里带着讽刺。
There was a note of sarcasm in his words.
use: 讽刺 + object; 真讽刺 = how ironic.

m: Both characters are made for this word: **grape**.
ex: 我买了一斤葡萄。
I bought half a kilo of grapes.
新疆的葡萄特别甜。
Xinjiang grapes are very sweet.
use: Measure word 串 (bunch) or 颗; 葡萄酒 = wine.

ex: 桌子上堆积着很多书。
Lots of books are piled up on the desk.
工作越堆积越多。
The work keeps piling up.
use: Often 堆积如山 (piled up like a mountain).

m: What you **love** and find **good**: a **hobby**; to **be fond of**.
ex: 你有什么爱好？
What are your hobbies?
他从小就爱好音乐。
He has loved music since he was little.
use: Mostly a noun: 我的爱好是……

m: A **steamed bun** (头 is a **head**-like noun suffix): a **steamed bun**.
ex: 北方人早饭常吃馒头。
Northerners often eat steamed buns for breakfast.
我买了两个馒头。
I bought two steamed buns.
use: Plain bun with no filling; 包子 has a filling.

m: **Search** your **nature** and just decide: you **might as well**.
ex: 雨太大了，我们索性不走了。
It's raining so hard, we might as well stay.
既然来了，索性玩一天吧。
Since we're here, we might as well spend the day.
use: Spoken; often after a reason, like 干脆.

m: **Raise** something until it **succeeds**: to **form** a habit.
ex: 孩子要从小养成好习惯。
Children should form good habits from an early age.
他养成了早起的习惯。
He got into the habit of getting up early.
use: Usually 养成……习惯.

m: A band on the **finger** that **guards** your promise: a **ring**.
ex: 他送给她一枚戒指。
He gave her a ring.
这个戒指是金的。
This ring is gold.
use: Measure word 枚 or 个; 结婚戒指 = wedding ring.

ex: 他暗示我该走了。
He hinted that I should leave.
我没听懂她的暗示。
I didn't get her hint.
use: Indirect suggestion; 心理暗示 = power of suggestion.

m: An **illness** as small as a **hair**: a **fault**, a defect.
ex: 我的车又出毛病了。
My car is playing up again.
他有一个爱迟到的毛病。
He has a bad habit of being late.
use: Faults in machines, bad habits, or minor illness.

ex: 长城非常雄伟。
The Great Wall is magnificent.
远处有一座雄伟的大山。
There is a majestic mountain in the distance.
use: For buildings, mountains and other large sights.

ex: 我买了一台数码相机。
I bought a digital camera.
他对数码产品很感兴趣。
He's very interested in digital gadgets.
use: Mostly "digital": 数码相机, 数码产品.

m: **Divided** into **ten thousand** parts, all of them: **extremely**.
ex: 我万分感谢你的帮助。
I'm extremely grateful for your help.
听到消息，她万分高兴。
She was overjoyed at the news.
use: Formal; before emotion words like 感谢, 激动, 抱歉.

ex: 花园里散发着花香。
The garden gives off the scent of flowers.
他在街上散发广告。
He's handing out leaflets in the street.
use: For smells, heat, light; or handing out flyers.

m: The **knot** tied at the end of the **game** (局): the **ending**.
ex: 这部电影的结局很感人。
The ending of this film is very moving.
谁也不知道最后的结局。
No one knows how it will end.
use: Endings of stories or events; 结果 is a result.

m: You **come** and **reach** it in time: to **have enough time**.
ex: 现在出发还来得及。
There's still time if we leave now.
别着急，你慢慢吃，来得及。
Don't rush, eat slowly; there's enough time.
use: Negative 来不及 = not enough time.

ex: 两只手摩擦可以生热。
Rubbing your hands together makes heat.
他们之间有点摩擦。
There's some friction between them.
use: Physical rubbing or minor conflict.

m: The **ache** is gone **fast**: **delighted**, to your heart's content.
ex: 我们今天玩得很痛快。
We had a great time today.
他很痛快地答应了。
He agreed straight away.
use: Also "straightforward": 说话很痛快.

m: **Transmit** directions to a **boat**: to **navigate**; sat nav.
ex: 开车的时候我用手机导航。
I use my phone for navigation when driving.
这个导航不太准。
This navigation app isn't very accurate.
use: Today mostly GPS navigation.

ex: 我每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
I drink a glass of milk every morning.
冰箱里没有牛奶了。
There's no milk left in the fridge.
use: Measure word 杯, 瓶 or 盒.

m: **Leave behind** and let it **stay**: to **hand down**.
ex: 这是战争遗留下来的问题。
This is a problem left over from the war.
古人遗留了很多珍贵的文物。
The ancients left behind many precious relics.
use: Often 遗留问题 (leftover problem).

m: A baby in the **bosom**, **pregnant**: to be **pregnant**.
ex: 她怀孕三个月了。
She's three months pregnant.
怀孕的时候不能喝酒。
You shouldn't drink alcohol while pregnant.
use: Plain everyday word; 有了 is a casual way to say it.

m: **Draw out** the shape of an **elephant** (image) until only an idea remains: **abstract**.
ex: 这幅画太抽象了，我看不懂。
This painting is too abstract for me to understand.
这个概念很抽象。
This concept is very abstract.
use: Opposite of 具体 (concrete).

ex: 大学时光过得真快。
University days pass so quickly.
我们一起度过了美好的时光。
We spent a wonderful time together.
use: Emotional, for periods of life; 时间 is plain time.

ex: 周末我们有个聚会。
We have a get-together this weekend.
老同学每年聚会一次。
Old classmates get together once a year.
use: Informal gatherings; 晚会 is a staged evening party.

ex: 我可以担保他是好人。
I can vouch that he's a good man.
他为朋友的贷款做了担保。
He guaranteed his friend's loan.
use: Often 为 + someone + 担保.

ex: 战争毁灭了这座城市。
The war destroyed this city.
这样下去会毁灭自己。
Carrying on like this will destroy you.
use: Strong word: total destruction.

ex: 这本书有十个单元。
This book has ten units.
我住在三号楼二单元。
I live in Entrance 2 of Building 3.
use: Units of a textbook; also a stairwell section of an apartment block.

ex: 不要有消极的想法。
Don't think negatively.
他对工作的态度很消极。
His attitude to work is very negative.
use: Opposite of 积极 (positive, active).

ex: 你是我们的骄傲。
You are our pride and joy.
取得成绩以后不要骄傲。
Don't get arrogant after you succeed.
use: Good sense "proud of"; bad sense "conceited", depending on context.

ex: 孩子们惊奇地看着魔术师。
The children watched the magician in amazement.
他的变化让我很惊奇。
I was amazed at how much he'd changed.
use: Amazement at something new; 吃惊 is closer to shock.

ex: 这个办法真高明！
That's a brilliant idea!
你另请高明吧。
You'd better find someone more capable.
use: Praises ideas, skill or people; also a place name (高明区).

ex: 我们去超级市场买东西吧。
Let's go shopping at the supermarket.
这部电影超级好看！
This film is super good!
use: Spoken "super" before adjectives; 超市 = supermarket.

ex: 物价不断高涨。
Prices keep soaring.
大家的热情很高涨。
Everyone's enthusiasm is running high.
use: For prices, moods, enthusiasm, water levels.

m: **Change** it to make it **good**: to **improve**, to **reform**.
ex: 科学家改良了水稻的品种。
Scientists improved the rice variety.
这辆车经过改良，更省油了。
After improvements, this car uses less fuel.
use: For crops, tools, methods; 改善 is for conditions.

ex: 这座城市正在复兴。
This city is undergoing a revival.
传统文化开始复兴了。
Traditional culture has begun to revive.
use: Formal; 文艺复兴 = the Renaissance.

m: With a **special** **idea** in mind: **specially**, on purpose.
ex: 我特意来看你。
I came specially to see you.
这是妈妈特意给你做的菜。
Mum made this dish especially for you.
use: Before verbs; close to 专门.

ex: 我不知道确切的时间。
I don't know the exact time.
请给我一个确切的回答。
Please give me a definite answer.
use: Before nouns like 时间, 消息, 数字.

ex: 大雪阻碍了交通。
Heavy snow obstructed traffic.
这些问题阻碍了公司的发展。
These problems held back the company's growth.
use: For progress and development, often abstract.

m: The **root** and the **root** again: the **origin**, the **root cause**.
ex: 我们要找到问题的根源。
We need to find the root of the problem.
贫穷是很多问题的根源。
Poverty is the root of many problems.
use: Usually 问题的根源; formal.

ex: 我们需要验证这个结果。
We need to verify this result.
请输入手机收到的验证码。
Please enter the verification code sent to your phone.
use: 验证码 = verification code.

ex: 他每天工作都很繁忙。
He's very busy at work every day.
这是一条繁忙的公路。
This is a busy road.
use: More formal than 忙.

ex: 火药是中国古代的四大发明之一。
Gunpowder is one of ancient China's four great inventions.
他说话总是带着火药味。
He always speaks with a hostile edge.
use: 火药味 = hostility in speech.

ex: 他用了一个很恰当的例子。
He used a very fitting example.
我觉得现在说这个不太恰当。
I don't think now is the right time to say this.
use: For words, methods, timing; close to 合适.

m: A **point** where something is **lacking**: a **weak point**.
ex: 每个人都有缺点。
Everyone has flaws.
这个手机的缺点是太重。
The downside of this phone is that it's too heavy.
use: Opposite of 优点 (strength).

ex: 他一个人坐在角落里。
He sat alone in the corner.
这首歌传遍了世界的每个角落。
This song spread to every corner of the world.
use: Inside corners; street corners are 拐角.

ex: 我喜欢运动，譬如游泳和跑步。
I like sports, for example swimming and running.
有很多办法，譬如坐地铁。
There are many ways, such as taking the subway.
use: More written than 比如.

m: A **trace** and an image (**elephant**, 象): a **sign**.
ex: 没有迹象表明他会来。
There's no sign that he will come.
经济出现了好转的迹象。
The economy is showing signs of improvement.
use: Often 有……的迹象.

m: **Attract** each other and tie a **knot**: to **collude**.
ex: 他和坏人勾结在一起。
He was in league with criminals.
有些官员和商人互相勾结。
Some officials and businessmen colluded with each other.
use: Always negative.

ex: 他想报复那个人。
He wants revenge on that man.
你别害怕他报复。
Don't be afraid he'll retaliate.
use: 对 + someone + 报复, or 报复 + someone.

ex: 现在几乎人人都有智能手机。
Now almost everyone has a smartphone.
人工智能发展得很快。
Artificial intelligence is developing fast.
use: 智能手机 smartphone; 人工智能 AI.

ex: 他打算竞选班长。
He plans to run for class monitor.
她竞选市长失败了。
She lost her run for mayor.
use: 竞选 + position.

ex: 这里的人口逐年增加。
The population here grows year by year.
他的收入逐年提高。
His income rises every year.
use: Before verbs of change; 逐渐 = gradually.

m: A **big** **tall building**: a **mansion**, a tower block.
ex: 我们公司在那座大厦的十楼。
Our company is on the tenth floor of that building.
城市里新建了很多大厦。
Many new high-rises have gone up in the city.
use: Used in building names: 国贸大厦.

m: **Break** and **gallop** around: to **toss and turn**, to fuss about.
ex: 他一夜折腾得睡不着。
He tossed and turned all night and couldn't sleep.
别折腾了，就这样吧。
Stop messing about, leave it as it is.
use: Spoken; read zhēteng. Also "to torment".

m: **Each other** in the same **place**: to **get along**.
ex: 他很好相处。
He's easy to get along with.
我和同事相处得很好。
I get on very well with my colleagues.
use: 和/跟 + someone + 相处.

ex: 我们傍晚去公园散步吧。
Let's go for a walk in the park in the early evening.
傍晚的时候下起了雨。
It started to rain towards evening.
use: The time just before dark.

ex: 把汤放在一边冷却一下。
Set the soup aside to cool for a bit.
他们的感情慢慢冷却了。
Their feelings slowly cooled.
use: Technical or figurative; 凉 is everyday.

ex: 我嗓子疼。
I have a sore throat.
她的嗓子很好，唱歌很好听。
She has a lovely voice and sings beautifully.
use: Both throat and singing voice.

ex: 这是一座宏伟的建筑。
This is a magnificent building.
他有一个宏伟的计划。
He has a grand plan.
use: For buildings and plans; 雄伟 is mainly for physical sights.

ex: 你们先走，我来掩护。
You go first, I'll cover you.
他在夜色的掩护下逃走了。
He escaped under cover of night.
use: Military; 在……的掩护下 = under cover of.

ex: 这个国家在赤道附近。
This country is near the equator.
赤道附近的天气很热。
The weather near the equator is very hot.
use: Geography term.

ex: 天上突然出现了一道闪电。
A flash of lightning suddenly appeared in the sky.
他像闪电一样跑了出去。
He shot out like lightning.
use: Measure word 道; 打雷 = thunder.

m: Right at your **heel** and **front**: **in front of**, near.
ex: 他走到我跟前。
He walked up to me.
孩子不在父母跟前。
The children don't live near their parents.
use: Spoken; after a person: 我跟前.

ex: 孩子的房间里有很多玩具。
There are lots of toys in the child's room.
我给儿子买了一个玩具车。
I bought my son a toy car.
use: Measure word 个 or 件.

ex: 士兵们隐蔽在树林里。
The soldiers hid in the woods.
这个地方很隐蔽。
This place is well hidden.
use: Military or for hidden places.

ex: 她脸上流露出高兴的表情。
A happy look showed on her face.
他很少流露自己的感情。
He rarely shows his feelings.
use: For emotions shown without words.

ex: 到了给我发个短信。
Send me a text when you get there.
我收到了一条短信。
I received a text message.
use: Measure word 条; 发短信 = send a text.

ex: 太晚了，况且外面还在下雨。
It's too late, and besides, it's still raining outside.
这本书很有用，况且也不贵。
This book is useful, and besides it isn't expensive.
use: Adds an extra reason; 而且 is more general.

ex: 双方最后都妥协了。
In the end both sides compromised.
我不会向困难妥协。
I won't give in to difficulties.
use: 向 + someone/something + 妥协.

ex: 请把这个消息传达给大家。
Please pass this message on to everyone.
这幅画传达了作者的感情。
This painting conveys the artist's feelings.
use: For messages, instructions, feelings.

ex: 人生总会遇到挫折。
Everyone meets setbacks in life.
他经历了很多挫折。
He has been through many setbacks.
use: 遇到挫折 = meet a setback.

ex: 请陈述你的理由。
Please state your reasons.
他向法官陈述了事实。
He stated the facts to the judge.
use: Formal; 陈述句 = declarative sentence.

m: **Defend** and **guard** the old ways: **conservative**; to keep a secret.
ex: 我父母的思想比较保守。
My parents are fairly conservative.
请你保守这个秘密。
Please keep this secret.
use: 保守秘密 = keep a secret; opposite of 开放.

ex: 一个人住有时候很寂寞。
Living alone is sometimes lonely.
老人在家觉得寂寞。
The old man feels lonely at home.
use: A feeling; 孤独 is closer to being alone.

m: **Carry** someone up and **pull** them higher: to **promote**.
ex: 他被提拔为经理了。
He was promoted to manager.
领导很想提拔年轻人。
The leadership is keen to promote young people.
use: Often 被提拔为 + post.

m: **Ask** the **world** to see it: to **come out**, be published.
ex: 第一台电脑是哪年问世的？
In what year did the first computer appear?
他的新书下个月问世。
His new book comes out next month.
use: For inventions, books, products.

ex: 这是一家正规的公司。
This is a legitimate company.
他没有受过正规的教育。
He didn't receive formal education.
use: Proper, legitimate, official.

ex: 天上的星星在闪烁。
The stars are twinkling in the sky.
他说话闪烁其词。
He speaks evasively.
use: 闪烁其词 = speak evasively.

ex: 这里的景色真美！
The scenery here is really beautiful!
秋天山上的景色很迷人。
The autumn scenery in the hills is enchanting.
use: Close to 风景; 景色 is slightly more literary.

ex: 我是自愿来帮忙的。
I came to help of my own free will.
参加活动完全是自愿的。
Taking part is completely voluntary.
use: 自愿者 is less common than 志愿者 (volunteer).

ex: 病人痛得一直呻吟。
The patient kept groaning in pain.
我听到隔壁有人在呻吟。
I heard someone moaning next door.
use: From pain or illness.

ex: 她脸上充满了喜悦。
Her face was full of joy.
我们分享了成功的喜悦。
We shared the joy of success.
use: Written; 高兴 is everyday.

ex: 他迫切地想见到家人。
He is eager to see his family.
这是一个迫切需要解决的问题。
This is a problem that urgently needs solving.
use: Often 迫切需要, 迫切希望.

m: The **wind** and **air** of a place: the **general mood**, the ethos.
ex: 这个学校的学习风气很好。
This school has a good study atmosphere.
我们要改变不好的社会风气。
We need to change bad social trends.
use: For habits shared by a group: 社会风气, 学习风气.

ex: 她性情温和。
She has a gentle temperament.
他是个性情古怪的人。
He is a man of odd temperament.
use: Close to 性格 (character).

ex: 这种香水的味道很持久。
This perfume's scent lasts a long time.
和平需要持久的努力。
Peace needs lasting effort.
use: 持久战 = protracted war.

ex: 糟糕，我忘带钥匙了！
Oh no, I forgot my keys!
今天的天气很糟糕。
The weather today is terrible.
use: As an exclamation: 糟糕！ = oh no!

ex: 银行在超市的左边。
The bank is to the left of the supermarket.
左边那个人是我哥哥。
The person on the left is my older brother.
use: 边 is neutral tone; same as 左面.

ex: 他是一个很浪漫的人。
He is a very romantic person.
我们在海边吃了一顿浪漫的晚餐。
We had a romantic dinner by the sea.
use: Loan from "romantic"; for love and dreamy moods.

m: **Hand over** like a **fork** crossing another: to **cross**, to **intersect**.
ex: 两条路在这里交叉。
The two roads cross here.
他双手交叉放在胸前。
He folded his arms across his chest.
use: 十字交叉 = crossroads.

ex: 你不应该欺骗别人。
You shouldn't deceive people.
我觉得自己被欺骗了。
I feel I've been deceived.
use: More formal than 骗.

ex: 学外语要多积累词汇。
When learning a language, build up your vocabulary.
他的词汇量很大。
He has a large vocabulary.
use: 词汇量 = vocabulary size.

ex: 这次活动的声势很大。
This campaign made a big splash.
他们虚张声势，其实没有力量。
They are bluffing; they actually have no strength.
use: 虚张声势 = bluff, make a show of strength.

ex: 这张桌子是木头做的。
This table is made of wood.
他像块木头一样站着不动。
He stood there like a block of wood.
use: Measure word 块 or 根; also "blockhead".

ex: 他在大会上发表了演讲。
He gave a speech at the conference.
我明天要用中文演讲。
Tomorrow I have to give a speech in Chinese.
use: 演讲比赛 = speech contest.

ex: 客厅里铺着一块地毯。
A rug is laid in the living room.
我们换了新地毯。
We got a new carpet.
use: Measure word 块 or 张.

m: **Feel** something deep and **impassioned**: to **sigh with emotion**.
ex: 看到老照片，他很感慨。
Seeing the old photos, he was filled with emotion.
她感慨时间过得太快了。
She sighed at how fast time had flown.
use: Mixed feelings, often nostalgia or regret.

m: The **rat** with the friendly prefix **old**: a **mouse**, **rat**.
ex: 厨房里有一只老鼠。
There's a mouse in the kitchen.
猫在抓老鼠。
The cat is catching a mouse.
use: Measure word 只; 老 adds no meaning of age.

m: **Open** the mind and **send out** ideas: to **enlighten**, inspire.
ex: 这本书给了我很大的启发。
This book really inspired me.
老师启发学生自己思考。
The teacher encourages students to think for themselves.
use: 受到启发 = be inspired.

m: A **legal case** used as an **example**: a **case**.
ex: 老师给我们讲了一个案例。
The teacher told us about a case.
这是一个成功的案例。
This is a successful case.
use: Used in law, medicine, business studies.

ex: 我讨厌下雨天。
I hate rainy days.
这个人真讨厌！
This person is so annoying!
use: Spoken; softer than 恨 (hate).

m: Where it **came** from and what it **experienced**: its **history**.
ex: 这个名字有什么来历？
What is the story behind this name?
这个人来历不明。
Nobody knows where this person came from.
use: 来历不明 = of unknown origin.

ex: 他的病情恶化了。
His condition got worse.
两国关系正在恶化。
Relations between the two countries are deteriorating.
use: For illness, relations, environment.

ex: 牛奶已经变质了。
The milk has gone off.
天热，食物容易变质。
In hot weather, food spoils easily.
use: For food going off; also people going bad.

ex: 不要把眼光局限在这个小地方。
Don't limit your vision to this small place.
这种方法有它的局限。
This method has its limitations.
use: Often 局限于 (limited to); 局限性 = limitations.

ex: 我们在湖边搭了一顶帐篷。
We pitched a tent by the lake.
晚上我们睡在帐篷里。
At night we slept in the tent.
use: Measure word 顶; 搭帐篷 = pitch a tent.

ex: 你可以把照片放大一点。
You can enlarge the photo a bit.
别把小问题放大。
Don't blow small problems out of proportion.
use: 放大镜 = magnifying glass.

ex: 她是个活泼的女孩。
She's a lively girl.
课堂气氛很活泼。
The atmosphere in class is lively.
use: For children, people, atmosphere.

ex: 他坐在窗边沉思。
He sat by the window lost in thought.
这个问题让我陷入了沉思。
This question set me thinking deeply.
use: 陷入沉思 = fall deep into thought.

ex: 这份工作薪水很高。
This job pays a high salary.
他每个月的薪水都花光了。
He spends his whole salary every month.
use: Same as 工资; 薪水 sounds a bit more formal.

ex: 他向我做了一个再见的手势。
He waved goodbye to me.
交警用手势指挥交通。
The traffic police direct traffic with hand signals.
use: 打手势 = gesture.

m: An imperial **court** and the ones that **substitute** for it: a **dynasty**.
ex: 唐朝是中国历史上有名的朝代。
The Tang was a famous dynasty in Chinese history.
你最喜欢哪个朝代？
Which dynasty do you like best?
use: Names end in 朝: 唐朝, 清朝.

ex: 贩卖毒品是严重的犯罪。
Drug dealing is a serious crime.
他在街上贩卖水果。
He sells fruit in the street.
use: Often negative: illegal trade.

ex: 她把一生奉献给了教育。
She devoted her whole life to education.
我们感谢你的奉献。
We thank you for your dedication.
use: 奉献给 + cause or people.

ex: 中文的语法不太难。
Chinese grammar isn't too hard.
这个句子有语法错误。
This sentence has a grammar mistake.
use: Also computer syntax.

m: The **tail** you **long for** to wag: a **tail**.
ex: 小狗高兴得摇尾巴。
The puppy wagged its tail happily.
猴子的尾巴很长。
The monkey's tail is very long.
use: Measure word 条; 巴 is a neutral-tone suffix.

ex: 他默默地离开了。
He left without a word.
妈妈一直默默地支持我。
Mum has always quietly supported me.
use: Usually 默默地 + verb.

ex: 这些杯子都是手工做的。
These cups are all handmade.
孩子们在上手工课。
The children are having a craft class.
use: 手工课 = handicraft class.

ex: 海水腐蚀了船底。
Sea water corroded the bottom of the ship.
金钱会腐蚀人的心灵。
Money can corrupt people's hearts.
use: Literal or moral corruption.

ex: 秘书正在起草一封信。
The secretary is drafting a letter.
这个文件是谁起草的？
Who drafted this document?
use: For documents, plans, letters.

ex: 他信心十足。
He's full of confidence.
他是一个十足的球迷。
He's a total sports fan.
use: After nouns (信心十足) or before (十足的).

ex: 我在山里迷失了方位。
I lost my bearings in the mountains.
方位词包括上、下、左、右。
Position words include up, down, left and right.
use: 方位词 = locative words.

ex: 动物园里有两只老虎。
There are two tigers at the zoo.
老虎是森林之王。
The tiger is king of the forest.
use: Measure word 只.

ex: 我看书的时候要戴眼镜。
I have to wear glasses when reading.
你的眼镜真好看。
Your glasses look great.
use: Measure word 副; 戴眼镜 = wear glasses.

ex: 他的神态很轻松。
He looked very relaxed.
画家画出了老人的神态。
The painter captured the old man's expression.
use: Look and bearing; more literary.

ex: 抽烟容易得癌症。
Smoking makes you more likely to get cancer.
她的癌症治好了。
Her cancer has been cured.
use: 得癌症 = get cancer.

m: A **knot** of **crystal**: to **crystallize**; the fruit of effort.
ex: 这本书是他多年心血的结晶。
This book is the fruit of his years of effort.
盐水蒸发后会结晶。
Salt water forms crystals when it evaporates.
use: Figurative: 智慧的结晶 = fruit of wisdom.

ex: 警察找到了新的线索。
The police found a new clue.
这条线索很重要。
This clue is very important.
use: Measure word 条.

ex: 部队驻扎在山下。
The troops are stationed at the foot of the mountain.
这里驻扎着一支军队。
An army is stationed here.
use: Military only.

ex: 努力就会成功，反之就会失败。
Work hard and you'll succeed; otherwise you'll fail.
多运动身体会好，反之会变差。
Exercise more and your health improves; otherwise it gets worse.
use: Written; 相反 is more spoken.

ex: 做事要凭良心。
You should act according to your conscience.
他这样做太没良心了。
It's heartless of him to do this.
use: 没良心 = heartless.

ex: 难怪他今天这么高兴。
No wonder he's so happy today.
外面下雪了，难怪这么冷。
It's snowing outside; no wonder it's so cold.
use: Starts a clause giving an explained surprise.

ex: 这些东西一共多少钱？
How much is all this altogether?
我们班一共有二十个学生。
Our class has twenty students in total.
use: Before numbers or 有; 总共 is a near synonym.

ex: 你的脸色很苍白，不舒服吗？
You look pale; are you unwell?
他的解释很苍白。
His explanation was feeble.
use: For faces; figuratively "weak, lifeless".

ex: 护士给病人注射了药物。
The nurse gave the patient an injection.
这种疫苗需要注射两次。
This vaccine needs two injections.
use: Medical; 打针 is everyday.

ex: 内在美比外表更重要。
Inner beauty matters more than looks.
这两件事有内在的联系。
These two things are intrinsically linked.
use: Opposite of 外在.

ex: 我们要从全局考虑问题。
We should consider problems from the overall perspective.
这件事影响全局。
This affects the whole situation.
use: 顾全大局 is similar: put the big picture first.

ex: 别生气，我是开玩笑的。
Don't be angry, I was joking.
你别跟我开玩笑了。
Stop kidding me.
use: 跟 + someone + 开玩笑; separable: 开个玩笑.

ex: 他的事迹感动了很多人。
His deeds moved many people.
老师给我们讲了英雄的事迹。
The teacher told us about the hero's deeds.
use: Praiseworthy deeds; 英雄事迹 = heroic deeds.

m: **Breathe** in and **take**: to **absorb**, to **draw** a lesson.
ex: 我们要吸取这次的教训。
We must learn from this lesson.
植物从土里吸取水分。
Plants absorb water from the soil.
use: 吸取教训 = learn a lesson.

ex: 孩子对什么都很好奇。
Children are curious about everything.
我很好奇他为什么不来。
I'm curious why he isn't coming.
use: 好 is hào here; 好奇心 = curiosity.

ex: 请按时吃药。
Please take your medicine on time.
他每天都按时上班。
He gets to work on time every day.
use: Before verbs; 准时 is a near synonym.

ex: 你最好早点睡。
You'd better go to bed early.
他是我最好的朋友。
He's my best friend.
use: 最好 + verb = had better.

m: **Praise** it and be **alike** in view: to **approve of**.
ex: 我赞同你的意见。
I agree with your opinion.
大部分人都赞同这个计划。
Most people support this plan.
use: Formal; 同意 is everyday.

ex: 这台电脑运算速度很快。
This computer calculates very fast.
小孩子在学习加法运算。
The kids are learning addition.
use: Maths and computing term.

m: A **key** (匙 only appears in this word): a **key**.
ex: 我找不到钥匙了。
I can't find my keys.
这把钥匙开哪个门？
Which door does this key open?
use: Measure word 把; 匙 is neutral tone shi.

m: A **point** of a **hundred** **divided** parts: a **percentage point**.
ex: 失业率下降了两个百分点。
Unemployment fell by two percentage points.
价格比去年高了五个百分点。
Prices are five percentage points higher than last year.
use: Measure word 个; for differences between percentages.

ex: 他们在山上采集草药。
They are gathering herbs on the mountain.
我们需要采集一些数据。
We need to collect some data.
use: For samples, plants, data.

ex: 请稍微等一下。
Please wait a moment.
这件衣服稍微有点大。
This garment is a little big.
use: Often with 一点, 一下, 有点.

m: **Stand** on your **feet** somewhere: to **have a footing**.
ex: 他在这个城市很难立足。
It's hard for him to get a foothold in this city.
我们要立足现在，看向未来。
We should base ourselves in the present and look to the future.
use: Often 立足于 (based on).

ex: 我把文件压缩了一下再发给你。
I'll compress the file before sending it to you.
我们要压缩开支。
We need to cut spending.
use: Files, space, costs, time.

m: **Say** you **resign** your place: to **take your leave**.
ex: 时间不早了，我先告辞了。
It's getting late; I'll take my leave.
他向主人告辞后离开了。
He said goodbye to the host and left.
use: Polite, said when leaving someone's home.

ex: 农民在山上放牧牲畜。
The farmers graze livestock on the mountain.
这个村子养了很多牲畜。
This village raises a lot of livestock.
use: Collective noun; for one animal use 牲口.

ex: 我们要遏制病毒的传播。
We must contain the spread of the virus.
政府采取措施遏制房价上涨。
The government took measures to curb rising house prices.
use: Formal; news language.

ex: 遇到危险要沉着。
Stay calm in the face of danger.
他沉着地回答了所有问题。
He calmly answered all the questions.
use: 着 is zhuó here; 沉着冷静.

ex: 我分辨不出他们俩谁是哥哥。
I can't tell which of the two is the older brother.
孩子要学会分辨是非。
Children must learn to tell right from wrong.
use: 分辨是非 = tell right from wrong.

ex: 他一个人在国外，感到很孤独。
Alone abroad, he feels very lonely.
老人过着孤独的生活。
The old man lives a solitary life.
use: Close to 寂寞; 孤独 stresses being alone.

ex: 老师帮他们调解了矛盾。
The teacher helped them settle their quarrel.
这件事需要第三方调解。
This matter needs a third party to mediate.
use: 调 is tiáo here.

m: **Heavy** with seriousness, like the old state of **Zheng**: **solemn**, serious.
ex: 他郑重地向大家道歉。
He solemnly apologized to everyone.
我郑重地告诉你，这不是开玩笑。
I'm telling you seriously, this is no joke.
use: Usually 郑重地 + verb.

ex: 士兵们在操场上操练。
The soldiers are drilling on the parade ground.
每天早上都有操练。
There's drill every morning.
use: Military drill or repeated practice.

ex: 春天是播种的季节。
Spring is the season for sowing.
农民们正在田里播种。
The farmers are sowing in the fields.
use: 种 is zhǒng here.

ex: 有话请当面说。
If you have something to say, say it to my face.
我想当面谢谢他。
I want to thank him in person.
use: Opposite of 背后 (behind someone's back).

ex: 请把窗户打开。
Please open the window.
窗户外面下着大雨。
It's pouring outside the window.
use: Measure word 扇 or 个; 户 is neutral tone.

ex: 中国人民很勤劳。
The Chinese people are hardworking.
她是一个勤劳的母亲。
She is a hardworking mother.
use: Praise word for physical work; 勤奋 for study.

ex: 这首歌凝聚了大家的心。
This song brought everyone together.
这本书凝聚了他十年的心血。
This book is the fruit of ten years of his effort.
use: 凝聚力 = cohesion.

ex: 这次成功有你一半的功劳。
Half the credit for this success is yours.
他从来不说自己的功劳。
He never talks about his own contributions.
use: 立功劳 = render service.

ex: 这是一家高档餐厅。
This is an upmarket restaurant.
他只买高档的衣服。
He only buys high-end clothes.
use: Opposite of 低档.

ex: 我的大学生活很充实。
My university life is full and rewarding.
他利用假期充实自己。
He uses his holidays to enrich himself.
use: 过得很充实 = lead a full life.

ex: 地铁的入口在哪里？
Where is the subway entrance?
我们在公园入口见面吧。
Let's meet at the park entrance.
use: Opposite of 出口 (exit).

ex: 他凌晨三点才睡觉。
He didn't go to bed until three in the morning.
飞机凌晨到达。
The plane arrives in the early hours.
use: Midnight to dawn.

ex: 学校买了一些体育器材。
The school bought some sports equipment.
这些器材很贵。
This equipment is expensive.
use: 体育器材, 摄影器材.

ex: 幸好你来了，不然我不知道怎么办。
Luckily you came, otherwise I wouldn't have known what to do.
幸好我带了伞。
Fortunately I brought an umbrella.
use: At the start of a clause; same as 幸亏.

ex: 他们受到了迫害。
They were persecuted.
很多人因为说真话被迫害。
Many people were persecuted for telling the truth.
use: Formal and serious.

ex: 景德镇的陶瓷很有名。
Jingdezhen's ceramics are famous.
这个碗是陶瓷做的。
This bowl is made of ceramic.
use: 陶瓷器 = ceramic ware.

ex: 天气预报说明天有雨。
The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
你今天看天气预报了吗？
Did you check the weather forecast today?
use: Mostly 天气预报.

m: **Speak** like a wild northern stranger (**胡**): to **talk nonsense**.
ex: 你别胡说！
Don't talk nonsense!
他在胡说，你别信。
He's talking rubbish; don't believe him.
use: Spoken, blunt; 胡说八道 is stronger.

ex: 他的想法很可笑。
His idea is ridiculous.
这有什么可笑的？
What's so funny about that?
use: Usually mocking; 好笑 is plain funny.

m: **Hope for** while gazing at the **full moon**: to **look forward to**.
ex: 孩子们盼望着过年。
The children are looking forward to New Year.
我一直盼望能见到你。
I've been longing to see you.
use: Often 盼望着; stronger than 希望.

m: Tie the **knot** on your **calculations**: to **settle a bill**.
ex: 请到前台结算。
Please settle the bill at the front desk.
工资每个月结算一次。
Wages are settled once a month.
use: Business word; 结账 is everyday.

m: **Indulge** in delay and make a **mistake**: to **hold up**.
ex: 对不起，耽误你的时间了。
Sorry for taking up your time.
别因为玩游戏耽误学习。
Don't let games get in the way of your studies.
use: 耽误时间 = waste/take up time.

m: Hold someone at the **pass** of your **bosom**: **care**.
ex: 谢谢大家对我的关怀。
Thank you all for your care.
社会应该关怀老人。
Society should care for the elderly.
use: More formal than 关心.

ex: 我有点恶心，想吐。
I feel a bit sick; I want to throw up.
这个味道真恶心。
This smell is disgusting.
use: 恶 is ě here.

ex: 他力图改变现状。
He strives to change the status quo.
公司力图扩大市场。
The company is trying hard to expand its market.
use: Formal; followed by a verb phrase.
